Best map painter even 13 years after release. Every minute of my life spent playing this game was worth it.

Europa Universalis IV is the hit sequel to the mega flop that was Europa Universalis V. Paradox learned from their mistakes when making EU5, and released the perfect game EU4. Mission trees, coherent gameplay, flavour, EU4 has it all. …

Too many DLC's and too expensive. Unless you absolutely want to play this game wait untill it is on a massive discount. Otherwise, skip it. Paradox is really out of control with how they make their products and monetize them.
